lessons_used: Predictions were consistently too high across all tests compared to noise-corrected results.

lessons_next: Predictions were generally too high compared to noise-corrected results across most tests.
Evidence is still thin for finish new_flow, choose_path copy, home notification, sign_in hint, sign_in layout, and sign_in notification because each has only 1 test.
No clear effect was seen for choose_path reorder changes across 2 tests.
Adoption redesign changes consistently reduced performance across 2 tests after noise correction.
Home wait_info changes showed mixed results across 2 tests, with one win (+4.2%) and one test showing no clear effect.
